title: poa secunda var. incurva
intro: Poa secunda var. incurva, commonly known as Bluebunch Wheatgrass or Curved Blue Wheatgrass, is a perennial grass species native to the mountainous regions of western North America. This plant has been traditionally used to support respiratory health, with potential health benefits including the alleviation of coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Poa secunda var. incurva are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe irritated tissues and facilitate the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional herbal medicine.
